title: Shadcn Lint: a linter where a design-system violation tells the agent which variant to use instead
description:
Shadcn Lint turns your Tailwind design rules into checks coding agents can run. You define which styles a component can change, then violations explain what went wrong and suggest alternatives from your existing design system. A button with forbidden padding can point the agent toward its size variants instead. It works with ESLint or Oxlint on Tailwind v4 projects, even if you don’t use shadcn/ui. #github #opensource 

https://github.com/shadcn-ui/lint
